mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is likely to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% MoM do not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal from PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines > 1% QoQ do not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.
